_comment: U.S. DOT & federal live-camera pack — batch 1 of an assisted web-research harvest (2026-08-26).
_provenance: Compiled from official state DOT / 511 traveler-information systems (DelDOT, MoDOT, WisDOT, Nevada DOT, Louisiana DOTD, GDOT, ADOT, Alaska DOT&PF, NCDOT DriveNC, Oregon TripCheck) plus one NPS webcam. Media URLs follow each system's published streaming pattern; per-entry liveness was checked during research (see license notes) but streams rotate — the app's per-camera health chips and bounded reconnects handle any that go dark. Coordinates come from provider metadata except entries marked posEstimated. Batch 2 (2026-08-26) adds 13 Maryland CHART cameras as page-linked markers: the research batch supplied provider coordinates but no per-camera stream URLs, so they were downgraded from the claimed 'hls' rather than shipped broken. Batch 4 (2026-08-27) adds 21 NPS park webcams (Yellowstone, Glacier, Mount Rainier, Yosemite, Great Smoky Mountains) as page-linked entries with per-camera nps.gov webcam pages; the Old Faithful row claimed 'hls' without a stream URL and was downgraded per the url-less rule. Batch 5 (2026-08-27) adds 12 NPS webcams — 10 with endpoint-checked direct still images on the nps.gov webcams-<park> path (plus one Pixelcaster CDN snapshot for Kolb Studio; a stale epoch cache-buster was stripped from the Big Bend URL) and 2 page-linked. Batch 6 (2026-08-27) adds 3 Idaho 511 cameras page-linked to the operator site root; the batch's two per-camera page ids were discarded as pattern-generated (sequential, inconsistent with the embedded camera numbers). Batch 7 (2026-08-27) adds 15 DelDOT HLS cameras (KCAM033-047), a contiguous US 13 corridor Dover-to-Harrington on the same verified video.deldot.gov stream pattern as batch 1; corridor coordinate progression validated monotonic. Batch 8 (2026-08-27) adds 43 WSDOT I-5 cameras (Bellingham to Olympia) page-linked to WSDOT's per-segment real-time camera pages; distance-per-milepost consistency validated per city cluster (the Fife segment runs east, so latitude monotonicity is the wrong invariant on this corridor). WSDOT publishes per-camera stills, but none were supplied and image paths are never constructed by pattern. Batch 9 (2026-08-27) adds 31 USGS volcano-observatory webcams page-linked (29 HVO: Kilauea + Mauna Loa; 2 YVO: Biscuit Basin) — real HVO instrument codenames, descriptive per-camera USGS page slugs, public-domain federal imagery; co-located instruments at shared stations were nudged apart by ~10 m so every camera stays individually clickable. Batch 10 (2026-08-27) adds 11 more NPS webcams (Acadia, Arches, Zion, Grand Teton, Wrangell-St. Elias, Glacier Bay, Glacier x4, Denali Puppycam) as page-linked entries with per-camera nps.gov webcam pages; the Grand Teton and Denali rows claimed 'hls' without stream URLs and were downgraded per the url-less rule; the two co-located Many Glacier instruments were nudged ~10 m apart to stay individually clickable.
_behavior: HLS entries play in-app (projection plane + panel player); page-only entries expose ACCESS LIVE FEED to the operator's own map/player. Disable this pack with CCTV_USDOT_ENABLED=0.
